fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM95,300. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/msu/0057142/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: Pass STPM / A-Level with full passes in at least two (2) subjects; OR Pass UEC with at least Grade B in five (5) subjects including Mathematics and English; OR Pass South Australian Matriculation (SAM) with a minimum score of 65–70%; OR Pass Foundation in Science or Engineering from recognised institutions; OR Pass Matriculation Certificate from the Ministry of Education Malaysia or equivalent; OR Pass Diploma from IKM / Community College / Polytechnic / other recognised IPT in related field (MQF Level 4); OR Other qualifications recognised as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia.
